test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose ‘No error’.**

Can you please help me to this project?
solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is: "**help me to**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct preposition to use after "**help**" is "**with**," not "**to**."
 
• The correct sentence should be: "*Can you please help me with this project?*"

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: "**this project?**" is missing the subject and verb of the sentence.
 
• Option 2: "**Can you please**" is not the error in the sentence.
